title: Auditioner orchestra registry (crawl sources for the open-auditions feed)
description: One entry per orchestra whose OWN public audition/vacancy page the crawler may read (PLAN F1/F2, docs/BOT.md). Honesty contract: every URL here was seen on the orchestra's own site (or in Tutti's verified data); never guessed from a pattern. Aggregator hosts are forbidden as auditionsUrl. If the audition page has not been found, auditionsUrl is omitted and notes says so.

id.description: Stable kebab-case id, unique in the file.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (PR for Puerto Rico, HK for Hong Kong).

auditionsUrl.description: The orchestra's OWN page that lists auditions/vacancies, exactly as seen. Never an aggregator. Omit if not yet found.

homepageUrl.description: The orchestra's own site, only if seen (the root of a domain that appeared in a search result, or Tutti's website field).

notes.description: Plain words for the next person: where the URL came from, what the page looks like (HTML/PDF list, individual postings), or 'audition page not yet found'.

source.description: Where this entry was seen: Tutti's data.json, the orchestra's own page (a search result), or a reference page (ICSOM roster, Wikipedia, news) when no official page has been seen yet.

groups.description: Optional tags for the PLAN F2 buckets this entry fills, e.g. icsom, tutti-socal, canada-majors, australia-six, uk-majors, europe-majors, japan.
